implementationRules: Use actual variants as an allowlist, never a Cartesian product of option labels.

One remaining watch variant -> fixed listing. More than one watch variant with one changing dimension -> single option. Two or more genuinely changing dimensions -> multi option.
Hide fixed option dimensions as read-only facts; DIDUN 12728036 has only one engine value.
Filter each field by existence of an allowed variant compatible with the other selections. Never quote an absent combination.
Keep model codes intact. A field named color can represent a whole watch, different engine, size or a watch set.
Do not interpret unlisted customization as impossible. Route requests beyond listed options to ICH for feasibility and price.
Use official variant.available only as listed ordering availability, not a promise of immediate stock.
Variant priceRaw is in cents; priceTwd=priceRaw/100. Use exact matched variant price, no universal component additions.
